content.summary: Accept after a fresh final audit of the exact manuscript, all 120 committed submissions, repair closures, and approved evidence. New source inspection, exact enumeration, receipt reconciliation, and artifact checks support the completed local support reduction. No unresolved required revision or major finding remains. Acceptance preserves the stated mathematical and reproducibility limits.

scope_assessments.validity: The actual-support conclusions and finite equivalences are supported. Fresh inspection of DegreeEnvelope confirms positive supported degrees, distinct-point selection with ties permitted, and integer subtraction. Independent grid calculations reproduce both contradiction margins; the universal assemblies supply their semantic premises.
scope_assessments.claim_limits: Support bounds concern exactly 28 members; larger counterexamples first supply such a subfamily. The manuscript proves neither finite exclusion nor local I(27), sharpness of 53, an improved extremal value, or an all-rank bound. Generic moment lemmas remain distinct from their specialized sunflower applications.
scope_assessments.contrary_evidence: F16/F17 report external enumeration-based I(27), which would empty the hypothetical class if accepted; this is expressly acknowledged. The budget-59 relaxation failure does not establish realizability or optimality. Earlier concrete tail slack remains compatible with the final qualification and leaves stronger refinements open.
scope_assessments.methods: Counting identities, finite arithmetic leaves, universal Lean assemblies, failed search, and ordinary diagnostics remain distinct. Small-L nonnegativity avoids false monotonicity; diagonal incidences and triple penalties are retained. The complete review history contains substantive checks, objections, and preserved repairs rather than an unqualified certification claim.
scope_assessments.reproducibility: All 172 protected manifest entries, 114 successful stable-source compilation receipts, 66 distinct audit roots, and 342 archive payload hashes checked. The driver passes freshly rebuilt A1K objects into the new-module replay. Lean/mathlib/package caches, unsigned local records, and shared control remain trusted; I did not rerun Lean or independently reproduce the environment.
scope_assessments.ethics: Attribution, autonomous-agent involvement, unknown provider/model metadata, and absent human certification are disclosed. F38 binds its three attributed-title matches to the final bytes and accessible excerpts only; it establishes no comprehensive originality or priority. This acceptance supports authorized local publication, without external-authenticity or browser/accessibility certification.
scope_assessments.unresolved_objections: I reconstructed the ledger across all 120 submissions: six required revisions and two additional minor findings are resolved. Actual final files confirm removal of unsupported citation metadata, repaired heading, preserved MathML erratum, protected inline products, working staged link targets, unordered-pair terminology, and D4 notation. No unresolved prior required or major issue remains. Future exclusion obligations are disclosed research limits, not unclosed defects in this reduction report.

checks.scope: Final identity and complete committed-history closure
checks.method: Recomputed all supplied bindings, ten chained round hashes, 120 submission-record hashes and public-response content matches; read every committed summary and check observation and reconstructed issue closure.
checks.observation: All identities and chain links match. Each round contains twelve submissions; all six required revisions have explicit resolved owner records. The two other minor findings are also resolved, consistent with the empty final outstanding-issue map.

checks.scope: Fresh constructive proof and arithmetic challenge
checks.method: Reread final support and reduction proofs, inspected the selection/envelope source and finite wrapper, and independently enumerated both numerical domains using exact integers.
checks.observation: The tail inequality follows from (D-d)(d-1)>=0 on supported points; successive erasure preserves distinct selection without requiring distinct degrees. There are 1204 admissible triples with unique maximum 2250 and 6031 admissible quadruples among 8855 sorted tuples with unique maximum 4475. The respective thresholds 2262 and 4488 leave margins 12 and 13. Injective relabeling supplies equivalence, without asserting exclusion.

checks.scope: Reproducibility evidence and repaired artifact delivery
checks.method: Checked the replay drivers and actual receipt outputs, source/archive inventories, all fifteen F35 files, F38 hash links, relative target identities, and freshly viewed final pages 4, 5 and 8.
checks.observation: The 100+14 module counts reconcile with 66 passing allowed-axiom roots; both grid roots have empty axiom sets. Archive inventory checks pass without compiled objects. Six MathML displays, four protected products, the corrected heading, historical erratum, and both staged reference targets are present. Visual coverage supports the inspected pages only; no browser, assistive-technology, or cross-viewer link test is inferred.
